# nerves_key v1.3.0 - Table of Contents

> Elixir support for the NervesKey

## Pages

- [NervesKey](https://nerves-key.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Hardware](https://nerves-key.hexdocs.pm/hw.md)

## Modules

- [NervesKey](https://nerves-key.hexdocs.pm/NervesKey.md): This is a high level interface to provisioning and using the NervesKey
or any ATECC508A/608A that can be configured similarly.

- [NervesKey.Config](https://nerves-key.hexdocs.pm/NervesKey.Config.md): This is a high level interface to provisioning and using the NervesKey
or any ATECC508A/608A that can be configured similarly.

- [NervesKey.Data](https://nerves-key.hexdocs.pm/NervesKey.Data.md): This module handles Data Zone data stored in the NervesKey.

- [NervesKey.OTP](https://nerves-key.hexdocs.pm/NervesKey.OTP.md): This module handles OTP data stored in the NervesKey.

- [NervesKey.ProvisioningInfo](https://nerves-key.hexdocs.pm/NervesKey.ProvisioningInfo.md)

## Mix Tasks

- [mix nerves_key.device](https://nerves-key.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.NervesKey.Device.md): Create a device certificate without a NervesKey
- [mix nerves_key.signer](https://nerves-key.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.NervesKey.Signer.md): Manages NervesKey signing keys
